title: test(app-shell): pin the writing end of the page-kind to node-type channel
body:
Part of #9718

Option (1) of the card's either/or: the guard is now real. The sentence is repaired to match what the guard actually does.

## What was false, re-measured on this branch's base (5e8a31aa1)

The comment above `PageView`'s kind-to-node-type mapping declared that changing the mapping would turn `page-kind-node-type-channel-9642` red "by design". It does not, and the reason is structural: `@object-ui/components` declares no dependency on `@object-ui/app-shell` (probe: zero app-shell entries across all four dependency kinds; lit control: 66 declared dependencies in that manifest; absent control: 0), so that pin's module graph cannot reach `PageView`.

## Both ablation directions, run on this branch, with their real output

Every run mutates on disk, proves the mutation landed (anchor count to 0, marker count to 1, blob hash changed), runs, then restores by `git checkout HEAD -- path` and proves the restore returned the HEAD blob byte for byte. Evidence taken at `a33fb2490`, the final commit.

### Direction A, the acceptance condition: gut the mapping to a constant `type: 'page'`

```
PRE  hash=2a8eb31007e967e129d935e3f1300c9dbcdf758b  HEAD blob=2a8eb31007e967e129d935e3f1300c9dbcdf758b
PRE  anchor count = 1        PRE  marker count = 0
POST hash=ce2e21310e96fb4c025f20c4efb5cdeee5fd4d9e
POST anchor count = 0        POST marker count = 1
MUTATION PROVEN ON DISK: bytes 8497 -> 8475
```

| surface | before this PR | with this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `page-kind-node-type-channel-9642` (reading end, `@object-ui/components`) | GREEN 5/5 | GREEN, unchanged |
| `page-kind-writing-end-9718` (writing end, `@object-ui/app-shell`) | did not exist | **RED** |

Combined run over both files: `Test Files 1 failed | 1 passed (2)` / `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)`. The failures name what broke:

```
AssertionError: PageView must hand the spec page KIND 'record' to SchemaRenderer VERBATIM as the
SchemaNode discriminator ComponentRegistry dispatches on - that write is the WRITING end of the
page-kind to node-type channel (objectui#9642). It wrote 'page' instead. If the mapping was
collapsed to a constant, every stored 'record' page now renders through the generic 'page' key and
loses the kind-specific registration; if the kind is new upstream, the channel has to be re-derived
before this is made green.
  Expected: "record"   Received: "page"
```

```
AssertionError: the node type PageView wrote for a stored 'record' page must select that kind's OWN
registry entry. It wrote 'page', which resolves to the entry labelled 'Page' where the kind's own key
resolves to 'Record Page'. Resolving to SOME page renderer is not enough - that is exactly what a
collapsed mapping still does, which is why this case compares entries rather than renderers.
-   "label": "Record Page",        +   "label": "Page",
-   "type": "ui:record",           +   "type": "ui:page",
```

Restore leg: `RESTORED hash=2a8eb31007e967e129d935e3f1300c9dbcdf758b` / `RESTORE PROVEN: git diff HEAD is [] (empty = clean)`.

### Direction B, the counter-ablation: delete the `utility` registration (the reading end)

```
PRE  hash=48fb71622bb4e1e459d79826d75dc97be4d6760c  (== HEAD blob)
PRE  anchor count = 1   POST anchor count = 0
MUTATION PROVEN ON DISK: bytes 32152 -> 32059
```

`Test Files 2 failed (2)` / `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed (9)` - both pins fire, each for its own reason:

- the 9642 pin, on the reading end it owns: *"page kind 'utility' is a member of @objectstack/spec PageTypeSchema ... ComponentRegistry must answer it with PageRenderer. It does not."* plus the enum-split case, `expected [ 'app', 'home', 'list', 'record' ] to deeply equal [ ... 'utility' ]`.
- the new pin, at a firing control rather than at its subject: *"the registry key 'utility' is unregistered, so the comparison below would compare two absences and pass without measuring anything. That is the READING end breaking, not the writing end: page-kind-node-type-channel-9642, in @object-ui/components, is the pin that owns it."*

Restore leg proven the same way.

## Why the pin lives in `@object-ui/app-shell`, and not where the card looked

The card and the dispatch both framed option (1) as needing a package that can import app-shell, and offered `apps/console` as the viable route. Measured on my own head, a third route is strictly cheaper and it is the one taken here: **the writing end IS an app-shell file**, and app-shell already declares `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react` and `@objectstack/spec` as dependencies. A pin inside app-shell therefore reaches both ends of the channel with **no new dependency edge at all**, and it sits beside the line it guards rather than two packages away.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.test.tsx` already mounts `PageView` through a stubbed `SchemaRenderer`; the new pin reuses that harness shape, so this route was not speculative.

The dead branch is confirmed dead: `packages/app-shell/package.json` declares `@object-ui/components: workspace:*`, so giving components an app-shell dependency closes a cycle. Not attempted.

## What the pin asserts

`page-kind-writing-end-9718` mounts `PageView` over a stored page document of each `PageTypeSchema` kind and reads the schema node it hands to `SchemaRenderer`:

1. every region-composed kind is written VERBATIM into the node discriminator, and carried again on `pageType`;
2. the node type written selects that kind's **own registry entry**, compared against the entry the kind's own key selects - because resolving to *some* page renderer is exactly what a collapsed mapping still does;
3. an untyped stored document falls back to the `page` node type and invents no `pageType`;
4. an interface-mode document reaches `InterfaceListPage` and writes no node type at all.

It does not re-assert the reading end's split. That remains `page-kind-node-type-channel-9642`'s job and nothing here weakens it.

## The four other citations are untouched

The pin is cited at 5 sites across `packages/`; the writing-end one was the false one. The other four - in `packages/types/src/registry.ts`, `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` and `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx` - are reading-end declarations and are byte-unchanged by this branch. No registration is added, removed or renamed; no render path changes.

ESLint, narrowed to the two changed source files with `--no-inline-config`: exit 0, 0 errors; 11 warnings, all `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` at severity 1, which `eslint .` does not fail on. The narrowing is defensible rather than merely convenient: the population comes from the config's own `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` entries, the file count 2 is read from `--format json` output, and this config enables no type-aware linting - no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`, no `*TypeChecked` preset - so nothing in this diff can move the verdict on a file it did not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` remains CI's run.

## Changeset

`check:changeset-presence` asked for one and named `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` as published source of a released package. The change is comment-only plus a test, so the changeset carries an EMPTY frontmatter - the gate's own documented first-class pass - and the gate now reads `Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter - declared as releasing nothing`. Confirmed by build: the new pin is absent from `packages/app-shell/dist` (0 hits; control: `PageView` appears twice).

## Acceptance condition

The gutting ablation flips. The sentence promises only that red, names the pin that delivers it, and states plainly that the 9642 pin cannot see this file.
